stroke-linecap="square"></path></svg></a></div></div></span><p>Grok Imagine video models turn a set of references, a still image, an existing clip, or a prompt into video with generated audio. <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-video-1.5</code></span> generates lip-synced speech, renders text-to-video and image-to-video at native 1080p, takes up to 14 reference images and 3 voice references, and pins first, last, and mid-video frames, in clips up to 15 seconds. <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite</code></span> does text-to-video and image-to-video with lip-synced speech at the lowest price per second, reaching 1080p by upscaling 720p. We recommend <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite</code></span> for simple videos, and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-video-1.5</code></span> when you need references, voices, pinned frames, or native 1080p.</p><p>Requests are asynchronous: submit, poll with the returned <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">request_id</code></span>, then download the clip. The xAI SDK and the Vercel AI SDK poll for you (<a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/generation#how-it-works" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">how it works</a>).</p></div><div data-wide-section="true" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl xl:max-w-5xl"><section class="not-prose my-8 flex
